 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Return the bottom-most (right-most in a tie) foreground object, cropped."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if not grid[r][c] or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
                        ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                        if (0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and
                                (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                            seen.add((ny, nx))
                            stack.append((ny, nx))
            objects.append((cells, color))
    cells, color = max(objects, key=lambda item: (max(r for r, c in item[0]), max(c for r, c in item[0])))
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    points = set(cells)
    return [[color if (r, c) in points else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
}

            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
                    for dx in (-1, 0, 1):

                                (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color):
                            seen.add((ny, nx))
                            stack.append((ny, nx))
            objects.append((cells, color))
    cells, color = max(objects, key=lambda obj: (max(r for r, c in obj[0]), max(c for r, c in obj[0])))
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    cell_set = set(cells)
    return [[color if (r, c) in cell_set else 0 for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
